correctness.rationale: For coordinates (p,u) representing p+2u modulo four, the output parity is p and the upper bits are u+p+q under the quandle product. Any preserving map has parity output constant in u, since p+q ranges over all translations. The upper output satisfies h(p,u+t)+h(p,u)=a(p)+a(p+t). At p=0 its increments are additive in t, forcing a(p)=Lp+c, and the equation at every p then forces h(p,u)=Lu+b_p; direct substitution proves sufficiency and uniqueness. With rank k let B=2^k, C=2^(r-k). The B output parity fibers are disjoint. In each, C input parities choose from C quotient cosets of im L, so occupancy t has (C)_t S(C,t) assignments, with B^C lifts and Bt image points. Multiplying fibers, rank-L counts and 2^r translations yields E_r. Rank-L counts come from choosing a k-space and a surjection onto it. Composition gives L^2=L, Lc=0 and b_(Lp+c)=(I+L)b_p. In each of the B fibers the fixed parity label x+c has b in ker L, with 2^(r-k) choices, and each other label must share that kernel component and has B choices of image component. The number of complementary kernels to a given image is 2^(k(r-k)), since each is the graph of a linear map from a fixed complement to the image. Multiplication by the choices of c gives I_r, including the constant maps (k=0) and identity (k=r). Each image has B fibers of size B, exactly one full coset of im L over each output parity; subtract its fiber offset and reindex by x in im L. The operation adds x+y to the second coordinate, giving Q_k, not merely the cardinality 4^k. All counts are of functions. For r=2 the independent counts match every coefficient, and substitution at r=3 gives I_3=64z+114688z^4+229376z^16+z^64 and E_3(1)=2^36.
residual_risks: The independent r=2 enumeration exhausts normal-form maps, not all 16^16 set maps; analytic necessity supplies exhaustiveness there and at arbitrary r.
